blocks.text: The Being the Gate Could Not Describe

Proposed story seed. A being whose activity depends on several local processes cannot fit a destination’s entry description. Engineers first propose a standardized embodiment. The participants instead develop a limited interface permitting a visit while retaining the traveler’s supporting organization. The arrangement succeeds for this case without solving every form of existence.

The gate is a local inter-environment passage, not the External Gate. The interface must retain real resource and permission limits. Supporting a remote presence does not establish that the whole being has migrated. Exact travel mechanism remains to be designed.
